extracted.name: Seasonal 'wealth greens' ('Fa cai')
extracted.description: Celebrate prosperity this Lunar New Year with seasonal greens like red chard, rich in nutrients and tinged with lucky red for a festive touch
ingredient_lines: 2½ cm piece ginger finely shredded into matchsticks
1 red chilli deseeded and finely chopped
instruction_lines: Mix the cornflour with 1 tbsp water and set aside. Heat a wok or pan over high heat until shimmering, then pour in the oil and give it a swirl. Season, then stir in the garlic, ginger and chilli. Add the chard and toss. Pour in the rice wine and cook, stirring, for less than 1 min. Pour in the soy sauce and the cornflour slurry and stir, then take off the heat and drizzle over the sesame oil. Serve immediately.
